checkpointing is not a problem specific to a particular system or programming model, and can be easily implemented as part of a distributed component system, such as XCAT3.

checkpointing can be implemented in a way that is transparent to the application programmer, while at the same time providing the application programmer with the ability to customize the checkpointing process.
